messages.subject: conditional panels
parts:
Hey. I'm trying to use conditional panels to display different pictures.

conditionalPanel(
          id="optie2",
          condition = "input.reference == 'Syrphidae'",
          img(src='./vleugels/zweefvlieg.jpg')
        ),   
        conditionalPanel(
            id="optie0",
            condition = "input.reference == 'Bees'",
            img(src='./vleugels/bees.jpg')
          ),
        conditionalPanel(
          id="optie1",
          condition = "input.reference == 'Lasioglossum'",
          img(src='./vleugels/lasioglossum.jpg')
        ),
          conditionalPanel(
            id="optie3",
            condition = "input.reference == 'Wasps'",
            img(src='./vleugels/vespa.jpg')
          )  

The problem is that the pictures dont change when you use the drop down menu. They only change to the selected input after you click the submit button.

Any ideas?        

Mart

messages.subject: Re: conditional panels
parts:
Sorry but you'll have to abandon the submit button and instead use actionButton/isolate together. This is a little more difficult but gives you much more control.
http://shiny.rstudio.com/articles/isolation.html
